explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D1 of the last few trials of the episode (about trial 91 onward), and only when the previous trial was rewarded, usually while the agent keeps choosing a1; GO, D2 and any D1 after an unrewarded trial are 0. It rises toward the episode end: about 2-6 around trials 91-96, about 6-9 at trial 97, and about 9-10 at trials 98-99.
